# Scrollia

> A free library of public-domain classics. No ads, no accounts. Read on the web or in the Android app.

Scrollia publishes editions that are free to use, with one edition per language when possible. Some translations are historical public-domain texts; others are Scrollia translations made with AI when no free digitized translation exists worldwide. AI translations are marked in the colophon and are CC0.

## Site

- Home: https://scrollia.org/
- Catalog: https://scrollia.org/catalog.html
- FAQ: https://scrollia.org/faq/
- Privacy: https://scrollia.org/privacy/
- Open Graph image: https://scrollia.org/assets/og-image.jpg

## Work pages

Each work has a page at `https://scrollia.org/book.html?id={work_id}` (for example `id=11` for Alice in Wonderland). The visible page is filled in by JavaScript from the API; crawlers that need title, author, and synopsis in the first HTML response will get that in a later server-side change.

Do not index the reader: https://scrollia.org/read.html is for humans reading EPUBs in the browser.

## API (catalog and files)

- Base: https://api.scrollia.org
- Site summary: GET /site
- Catalog: GET /books
- Work record: GET /works/{id}
- Cover: GET /works/{id}/cover.jpg
- EPUB download: GET /download/{edition_id}.epub

EPUB files are for readers. Do not bulk-scrape `/download/`. Prefer work pages and `/works/{id}` for metadata.
